results.name: round trip: the sealed draft opens with the password to the identical bytes; the key derivation is cached
a wrong password, a case change and an empty password are refused as 'password', without throwing
damage is never opened and never mistaken for a wrong password: non-base64, plaintext, truncation, a flipped byte
no leak: the sealed bytes contain neither the password (UTF-8 / UTF-16LE) nor the plaintext marker
restoredProtection never weakens: the file's password wins; an unprotected file adopts the draft's; plain drafts change nothing
the draft codec accepts encoding 'sealed' only with a base64 payload
Spreadsheet packing: the draft JSON travels as a one-entry ZIP; unicode round-trips; other ZIPs are refused
outside oracle: msoffcrypto-tool (HMAC verified) decrypts both sealed drafts; python-docx reads the Writer one; a wrong password fails there too
